spec_case: issue #403: a member-access chain past the explicit CEL nesting limit
description: A 37-link member-access chain is rejected at compile time, before the document ever runs, the same way every other over-limit construct is -- one explicit depth limit (32), checked once per expression right after it parses, replaces cof's old floor (wherever CPython's own recursion happened to give out for this shape, which varied by Python version). No longer pinned to one Python runner version, because the check no longer depends on one.
